notes: Idea: contactor inrush into ESC input capacitors on the open tennis feeder. Closed-form series RLC (checked vs RK4 in 3 dampings, I^2t=CV^2/2R). Defaults (assumed): direct close 394 A, 170 us over an assumed 150 A BMS trip; 27-case sweep 242-589 A, 9/27 past a 200 us delay. Added 4.7 ohm precharge + relay + 0.5 s on-delay through the e-stop: contactor makes 19.6 A (29 A worst). Verification: open-tennis-robots src tests 90 OK, node 21 pass, cad tests 96 OK (build123d 0.13.0 venv; includes committed package == fresh build); flagship_field --check and check_post_frontmatter clean.
